name: Ripuka
source:
"Hehehe. Beg for death. I want to see the light leave your eye..."

Her desire to kill inspires her to commit unfathomable atrocities...

A member of the Ludens, a mysterious group of beings that suddenly appear in World's Odyssey. She is obsessed with murders and massacres.

[From [url=https://ideafintl.com/death-request/chara/]Idea Factory[/url]]
